text:
Predicates:
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Composer(x) ::: x is a composer.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Premiered(x, y) ::: x premiered y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Premises:
MusicPiece(symphonyNo9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
∀x (Composer(x) → MusicPiece(x)) ::: Composers write music pieces.
Wrote(beethoven, symphonyNo9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiered(viennaMusicSociety, symphonyNo9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
∀x (Orchestra(x) → Conductor(x)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
Composer(beethoven) ::: Beethoven is a composer.
